stem:
The graph below shows the humidity in a room as recorded on a certain morning.

[Image: Graph of Humidity in Room]

On the morning shown in the graph, how many times between 6 a.m. and 12 noon was the humidity exactly 20 percent?
figure_description: A line graph titled "Humidity in Room". The vertical axis is labeled "Percent Humidity" with horizontal grid lines and markings at 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50. The horizontal axis is labeled "Time (a.m.) in hours" with vertical grid lines and markings at 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 noon. A continuous curve starts at (6, 5), rises through (7, 20) to a peak at (8, 40), then decreases passing through (9, 30) and (10, 20) to a minimum of about 14 between 10 and 11, then rises passing 20 between 11 and 12, reaching 25 at 12 noon. The curve intersects the horizontal line for 20 percent humidity at three points: at 7 a.m., at 10 a.m., and between 11 a.m. and 12 noon.
